title: Create Sales Lines with Copilot in Dynamics 365 Business Central (2024)

chapters.title: How Copilot Identifies and Suggests Products

features.name: Copilot for Sales Order Creation
features.description: Copilot in Dynamics 365 Business Central automates the process of creating sales orders, invoices, and quotes by identifying products from customer emails or descriptions and suggesting matching items from the product catalog.

features.name: Email-based Order Details Processing
features.description: Users can copy product details from customer emails and paste them directly into Business Central, where Copilot identifies the products and suggests matches from the catalog.

features.name: Previous Order Reference
features.description: Copilot can reference previous orders to help find items that have been sold before, streamlining the creation of repeat orders.

features.name: Natural Language Product Description
features.description: Users can describe goods or services needed with just a few words, and Copilot suggests matching line items from the product catalog based on this natural language input.
